examples.text: ādiyamāno'ti ādiyamāno haramāno avaharamāno iriyāpathaṃ vikopayamāno ṭhānā cāvayamāno saṅketaṃ vītināmayamāno.
yā c'āvuso, paññā yañ'ca viññāṇaṃ, ime dhammā saṃsaṭṭhā udāhu visaṃsaṭṭhā? labbhā ca pan'imesaṃ dhammānaṃ vinibbhujitvā vinibbhujitvā nānākaraṇaṃ paññāpetun'ti?
katamā c'āvuso, animittā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, animittā cetovimutti.
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuṃ duṭṭho doso appatīto amūlakena pārājikena dhammena anuddhaṃseyya app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti
app'eva nāma naṃ imamhā brahmacariyā cāveyyan'ti bhikkhubhāvā cāveyyaṃ, samaṇadhammā cāveyyaṃ, sīlakkhandhā cāveyyaṃ, tapoguṇā cāveyyaṃ.

siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, uddesā no cāvetu'kāmo samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yo eva vo uddeso so eva vo uddeso hotu.

26510.commentary: (DNa) uddesā no cāvetu'kāmo'ti attano anusāsaniṃ gāhāpetvā amhe amhākaṃ uddesato cāvetu'kāmo.

examples.text: yāvatā, bho, rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ yattha ca rājā pasenadi kosalo issariy'ādhipaccaṃ rajjaṃ kāreti, pahoti tattha rājā pasenadi kosalo samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā puññavantaṃ vā apuññavantaṃ vā brahmacariyavantaṃ vā abrahmacariyavantaṃ vā tamhā ṭhānā cāvetuṃ vā pabbājetuṃ vā'ti.

26511.meaning1: to make shift; to cause to move (from)

26512.meaning2: having caused to bring to fall, having caused to drive away

26514.meaning2: caused to bring to fall, caused to drive away

examples.text: abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.
yen'eva bālo'ti paraṃ dahāti, ten'ātumānaṃ kusalo'ti c'āha, sayam'attanā so kusalo vadāno, aññaṃ vimāneti tadeva pāva.
na c'āhaṃ, āvuso, appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ dukkhassa antakiriyaṃ vadāmi.
atha kassa c'āhaṃ, bho gotama, imaṃ pāyasaṃ dammī'ti?

na kho pana so, sāriputta, saṃsāro sulabharūpo yo mayā asaṃsaritapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā, aññatra suddh'āvāsehi devehi. suddh'āvāse c'āhaṃ, sāriputta, deve saṃsareyyaṃ, na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgaccheyyaṃ.
na c'āhu na ca bhavissati, na c'eta'r'ahi vijjati, ek'antaṃ nindito poso, ek'antaṃ vā pasaṃsito.
evam'pi viggayha vivādayanti, bālo paro akusalo'ti c'āhu, sacco nu vādo katamo imesaṃ, sabb'eva h'īme kusalā vadānā.
saṅkhāya lokasmiṃ paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.
alam'ettāvatā katam'ettāvatā, anuppatto no sāmaññ'attho, n'atthi no kiñci uttariṃ karaṇīyan'ti tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhiṃ āpajjeyyātha.
abbhāse vattamānassa kavaggassa cavaggo hoti. cikicchati, jigucchati, jighacchati, jigīsati, jaṅgamati, caṅkamati.
māna kita'icc'etesaṃ dhātūnaṃ abbhāsagatānaṃ vakāra takārattaṃ hoti vā yathāsaṅkhyaṃ. vīmaṃsati, tikicchati. vā'ti kim'atthaṃ? cikicchati.
bhājanagataṃ udakaṃ vā kañjikaṃ vā khīraṃ vā takkaṃ vā rajanaṃ vā passāvaṃ vā cikkhallaṃ vā kīḷati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

26525.meaning2: flying wheel made of a palm leaves, etc.

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.

atha kho, bhikkhave, rathakāro yaṃ taṃ cakkaṃ chahi divasehi niṭṭhitaṃ taṃ pavattesi. taṃ pavattitaṃ samānaṃ yāvatikā abhisaṅkhārassa gati tāvatikaṃ gantvā ciṅgulāyitvā bhūmiyaṃ papati. yaṃ pana taṃ cakkaṃ chahi māsehi niṭṭhitaṃ chāratt'ūnehi taṃ pavattesi.

seyyath'idaṃ, aṭṭhapadaṃ dasapadaṃ ākāsaṃ parihārapathaṃ santikaṃ khalikaṃ ghaṭikaṃ salākahatthaṃ akkhaṃ paṅgacīraṃ vaṅkakaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulikaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ akkharikaṃ manesikaṃ yathāvajjaṃ

26532.commentary: (THIa) rāgañ'ca ahaṃ dosañ'ca, cicciṭi cicciṭī'ti vihanāmī'ti ahaṃ kilesajeṭṭhakaṃ rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca cicciṭi cicciṭī'ti iminā saddena saddhiṃ vihanāmi vināsemi, pajahāmī'ti attho. sā kira attano sāmikaṃ jigucchantī tena divase divase phāliyamānānaṃ sukkhānaṃ veḷudaṇḍ'ādīnaṃ saddaṃ garahantī tassa pahānaṃ rāgadosapahānena samaṃ katvā avoca.

examples.text: rāgañ'ca ahaṃ dosañ'ca, cicciṭi cicciṭī'ti vihanāmi, sā rukkhamūlam'upagamma, aho sukhan'ti sukhato jhāyāmī'ti.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, tinduk'ālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhiyyosomattāya cicciṭāyati ciṭiciṭāyati.

26537.commentary: (THa) idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ idāni maṃ tvaṃ pahāya attano purimāciṇṇaṃ mah'icchat'ādiṃ paṭipajjasi, kiṃ nām'etan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: app'icchatā sappurisehi vaṇṇitā, makkhappahānaṃ vūpasamo dukhassa, iti'ssu maṃ citta tadā niyuñjasi, idāni tvaṃ gacchasi pubbaciṇṇaṃ.
suciṇṇaṃ brahmacariyaṃ me, maggo c'āpi subhāvito, maraṇe me bhayaṃ n'atthi, rogānam'iva saṅkhaye.
parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.

26539.commentary: (THIa) ciṇṇā aṅgā ca magadhā'ti ye ime aṅgā ca magadhā ca vajjī ca kāsī ca kosalā ca janapadā pubbe sāṇāya mayā raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjantiyā ciṇṇā caritā

examples.text: ciṇṇā aṅgā ca magadhā, vajjī kāsī ca kosalā, anaṇā paṇṇāsavassāni, raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ abhuñj'ahaṃ.

26541.meaning1: place travelled to; location walked to

examples.text: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ, ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
cit'antar'aṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
tā kho pan'ānanda, pokkharaṇiyo catunnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ iṭṭhakāhi citā ahesuṃ, ekā iṭṭhakā sovaṇṇamayā, ekā rūpiyamayā, ekā veḷuriyamayā, ekā phalikamayā.
na tāva bhagavato citako pajjalissati, yāv'āyasmā mahākassapo bhagavato pāde sirasā na vandissatī'ti. yathā, bhante, devatānaṃ adhippāyo, tathā hotū'ti.

26549.meaning1: with full upper back; with a swelling between the shoulders; (comm) with space between the shoulders filled; eighteenth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
26549.commentary: (MNa) cit'antar'aṃso'ti antar'aṃsaṃ vuccati dvinnaṃ koṭṭānam'antaraṃ, taṃ citaṃ paripuṇṇam'assā'ti cit'antar'aṃso.

examples.text: cit'antar'aṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

26550.meaning1: devotional offering to a funeral pyre

examples.text: kandanti naṃ ñātī pakiriya kese, ahovatā no amarā'ti c'āhu, vatthena naṃ pārutaṃ nīharitvā, citaṃ samādhāya tatoḍahanti.
tam'enaṃ dve balavanto purisā nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuṃ upakaḍḍheyyuṃ. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māgaṇḍiya, api nu so puriso iti c'itic'eva kāyaṃ sannāmeyyā'ti? evaṃ, bho gotama.

26555.commentary: (VIN 1.1.3) iti cittamano'ti yaṃ cittaṃ taṃ mano, yaṃ mano taṃ cittaṃ.

examples.text: dunniggahassa lahuno, yatthakāmanipātino, cittassa damatho sādhu, cittaṃ dantaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.
yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo samādhisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

tassa evaṃ hoti, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā khattiyamahāsālānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti. so taṃ cittaṃ dahati, taṃ cittaṃ adhiṭṭhāti, taṃ cittaṃ bhāveti. tassa te saṅkhārā ca vihārā ca evaṃ bhāvitā evaṃ bahulīkatā tatrupapattiyā saṃvattanti.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evaṃ hoti, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sakaṃ cittaṃ nikkhipitvā imesaṃ'y'eva āyasmantānaṃ cittassa vasena vatteyyan'ti.
etha passath'imaṃ lokaṃ, cittaṃ rājarath'ūpamaṃ, yattha bālā visīdanti, n'atthi saṅgo vijānataṃ.
añjanī'va navā cittā, pūtikāyo alaṅ'kato, alaṃ bālassa mohāya, no ca pāragavesino.

n'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, aññaṃ ekanikāyam'pi samanupassāmi evaṃ cittaṃ yatha'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā, te'pi kho, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatā pāṇā citten'eva cittitā, tehi'pi kho, bhikkhave, tiracchānagatehi pāṇehi cittaññ'eva cittataraṃ.
diṭṭhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ nāma cittan'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tam'pi kho, bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ nāma cittaṃ citten'eva cittitaṃ. tena'pi kho, bhikkhave, caraṇena cittena cittaññ'eva cittataraṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā

26560.meaning1: name of a lay-disciple; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost layman in giving Dhamma talks; Citta Macchikāsaṇḍika
26560.commentary: (ANa) dhammakathikānan'ti dhammakathikānaṃ upāsakānaṃ citto, gahapati, aggo'ti dasseti. so kira padum'uttarabuddhakāle haṃsavatiyaṃ kulagehe nibbatto aparabhāge dhammakathaṃ suṇanto satthāraṃ ekaṃ upāsakaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ aggaṭṭhāne ṭhapentaṃ disvā adhikārakammaṃ katvā taṃ ṭhān'antaraṃ patthesi. so kappasatasahassaṃ devamanussesu saṃsaritvā kassapabuddhakāle migaluddakagehe nibbatto aparabhāge araññe kammaṃ kātuṃ samatthakāle ekadivasaṃ deve vassante migamāraṇ'atthāya sattiṃ ādāya araññaṃ gantvā migarūpāni olokento ekasmiṃ akatapabbhāre sasīsaṃ paṃsukūlaṃ pārupitvā pāsāṇaphalake nisinnaṃ ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ disvā eko ayyo samaṇadhammaṃ karonto nisinno bhavissatī'ti saññaṃ uppādetvā vegena gharaṃ gantvā ekasmiṃ uddhane hiyyo ābhatamaṃsaṃ, ekasmiṃ bhattaṃ pacāpetvā piṇḍācārike dve bhikkhū disvā tesaṃ pattaṃ ādāya paññattāsane nisīdāpetvā bhikkhaṃ samādāpetvā, ayye, parivisathā'ti aññe āṇāpetvā taṃ bhattaṃ kuṭe pakkhipitvā paṇṇena mukhaṃ bandhitvā kuṭaṃ ādāya gacchanto antarāmagge nānāvidhāni pupphāni ocinitvā pattapuṭakena gahetvā therassa nisinnaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā kuṭaṃ otāretvā ekam'ante ṭhapetvā mayhaṃ, bhante, saṅgahaṃ karothā'ti vatvā therassa pattaṃ ādāya bhattassa pūretvā therassa hatthe patiṭṭhapetvā tehi missakapupphehi theraṃ pūjetvā ekam'ante ṭhito yath'āyaṃ rasapiṇḍapātena saddhiṃ pupphapūjā cittaṃ paritoseti, evaṃ nibbatta-nibbatta-ṭṭhāne me paṇṇākārasahassāni c'eva āgacchantu pañcavaṇṇakusumavassañca vassatū'ti āha.

examples.text: atha kho citto gahapati yena therā bhikkhū ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho citto gahapati there bhikkhū etadavoca
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ citto gahapati macchikāsaṇḍiko.

26561.meaning1: name of a monk; Citta Hatthisāriputta
26561.meaning2: name of a monk; Citta Hatthisāriputta
26561.commentary: (DNa) citto ca hatthisāriputto'ti so kira sāvatthiyaṃ hatthi-ācariyassa putto bhagavato santike pabbajitvā tīṇi piṭakāni uggahetvā sukhumesu atthantaresu kusalo ahosi, pubbe katapāpakammavasena pana sattavāre vibbhamitvā gihi jāto… poṭṭhapādassa pan'āyaṃ gihisahāyako hoti. tasmā vibbhamitvā dvī'hatī'h'accayena poṭṭhapādassa santikaṃ gato. atha naṃ so disvā samma kiṃ tayā kataṃ, evarūpassa nāma satthu sāsanā apasakkanto'si, ehi pabbajituṃ idāni te vaṭṭatī'ti taṃ gahetvā bhagavato santikaṃ agamāsi. tena vuttaṃ citto ca hatthisāriputto poṭṭhapādo ca paribbājako'ti.

examples.text: atha kho dvī'ha-tī'hassa accayena citto ca hatthisāriputto poṭṭhapādo ca paribbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā citto hatthisāriputto bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

26567.commentary: (DHPa) cittakatan'ti katacittaṃ, vatth'ābharaṇa-māl'ālattak'ādīhi vicittan'ti attho. (THa) cittakatan'ti cittaṃ kataṃ cittakataṃ, vatth'ābharaṇamāl'ādīhi vicittaṃ katan'ti attho.

examples.text: passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
passa cittakataṃ rūpaṃ, maṇinā kuṇḍalena ca. aṭṭhiṃ tacena onaddhaṃ, saha vatthehi sobhati.
arati viya me'jja khāyati, bahuke disvāna vivitte āsane, te cittakathā bahussutā, kome gotamasāvakā gatā'ti.
sīlavatī cittakathā, bahussutā buddhasāsane vinītā, mātāpitaro upagamma, bhaṇati ubhayo nisāmetha.

26570.commentary: (ANa) cittakathikānan'ti vicittaṃ katvā dhammaṃ kathentānaṃ. thero kira ekassa'pi dvinnam'pi dhammaṃ kathento bahūhi upamāhi ca kāraṇehi ca maṇḍayitvā bodhento katheti. tasmā cittakathikānaṃ aggo nāma jāto.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ cittakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ kumārakassapo.
paccay'ākārakusalā, catusaccavisāradā, nipuṇā cittakathikā, satthusāsanakārikā.

26571.commentary: (THa) cittakathī'ti vicittadhammakathikā, saṅkhipanaṃ, vitthāraṇaṃ gambhīrakaraṇaṃ uttānīkaraṇaṃ kaṅkhāvinodanaṃ dhammapatiṭṭhāpananti evam'ādīhi nānānayehi paresaṃ ajjhāsayānurūpaṃ dhammassa kathanasīlā'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ kaccānaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato, paṇḍito viyatto medhāvī bahussuto cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhāno vuddho c'eva arahā ca. sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī'ti.
bahussuto cittakathī, buddhassa paricārako, pannabhāro visaññutto, seyyaṃ kappeti gotamo.

26573.meaning1: mind that is bad luck; mind of ill omen
26573.meaning2: mind that is bad luck; mind of ill omen

examples.text: tvaṃ olaggo na gacchasi, dvāravivaraṃ gajo'va alabhanto, na ca cittakali punappunaṃ, pasakka pāparato carissasi.

26575.commentary: (THIa) cittakārasukatā'va lekhikā'ti cittakārena sippinā nīlāya vaṇṇadhātuyā suṭṭhu katā lekhā viya sobhate.

examples.text: cittakārasukatā'va lekhikā, sobhare su bhamukā pure mama, tā jarāya valibhippalambitā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe phalake vā bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṃ vā purisarūpaṃ vā abhinimmineyya sabb'aṅgapaccaṅgiṃ.

26577.meaning1: mental fatigue; exhaustion of the mind

examples.text: ekam'ekena'pi kho, bhante, bojjhaṅgena samannāgato yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya, ko pana vādo sattahi bojjhaṅgehi? yo'pi me, bhante, gijjhakūṭaṃ pabbataṃ ārohantassa kāyakilamatho cittakilamatho, so'pi me paṭippassaddho, dhammo ca me abhisamito'ti.

26578.meaning1: name of one of the five mountains surrounding lake Anotatta in the Himalayas

examples.text: tesu anotattadaho sudassanakūṭaṃ cittakūṭaṃ kāḷakūṭaṃ gandhamādanakūṭaṃ kelāsakūṭan'ti imehi pañcahi pabbatakūṭehi parikkhitto.
kāmacchando ca byāpādo, thinamiddhañ'ca bhikkhuno, uddhaccaṃ vicikicchā ca, pañc'ete cittakelisā.
ye pana te sutt'antā kavikatā kāveyyā citt'akkharā cittabyañjanā bāhirakā sāvakabhāsitā, tesu bhaññamānesu sussūsissanti, sotaṃ odahissanti
mandattā momūhattā aññaṃ byākaroti, pāp'iccho icch'āpakato aññaṃ byākaroti, ummādā cittakkhepā aññaṃ byākaroti, adhimānena aññaṃ byākaroti, samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaroti.
vedanaṃ pharusaṃ jāniṃ, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, garukaṃ vā'pi ābādhaṃ, cittakkhepañ'ca pāpuṇe.
tatr'ābhiratim'iccheyya, hitvā kāme akiñcano, pariyodapeyya attānaṃ, cittaklesehi paṇḍito.

26583.meaning2: who speaks brilliantly; whose talk is varied

26586.commentary: (SNa) cittaññ'eva cittataran'ti tassa cittassa upāyapariyesanacittaṃ tato'pi cittataraṃ.

examples.text: diṭṭhaṃ vo, bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ nāma cittan'ti? evaṃ, bhante. tam'pi kho, bhikkhave, caraṇaṃ nāma cittaṃ citten'eva cittitaṃ. tena'pi kho, bhikkhave, caraṇena cittena cittaññ'eva cittataraṃ.

26587.grammar: fem, abstr, in comps, from citta
26587.meaning1: fact of having such a mind; having such a mental state

examples.text: so sīlavā samāno bhabbo ariyānaṃ adassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammassa asotu'kamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.

26590.commentary: (MNt) hatth'attharaṇā hatthirūpavicittā. ass'attharaka-sīh'attharak'ādayo'pi assasīharūp'ādivicittā eva attharakā, citt'attharakaṃ nānārūpehi c'eva nānāvidhamālākamm'ādīhi ca vicittaṃ attharakaṃ.

26591.meaning2: mind that is an injurer; treacherous mind?

26594.meaning2: having the interval of a thought moment

26595.meaning1: conforming to the mind; subject to the mind; subservient to the mind

examples.text: tassa kho eso, bho gotama, citt'anvayo kāyo hoti, cittassa vasena vattati. taṃ kissa hetu? abhāvitattā kāyassa.

26596.meaning1: experiencing the mind; conscious of psyche; sensitive to the mind

examples.text: cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati. abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, abhippamodayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.

26598.meaning2: which equips, makes fit the thinking

26599.meaningLit: for the purpose of supporting the mind
26599.construction:
citta + parikkhāra + attha + aṃ
cittaparikkhārattha + aṃ
26599.commentary: (DNa) citt'ālaṅ'kāra-cittaparikkhār'atthaṃ dānaṃ detī'ti samathavipassanā-cittassa alaṅ'kār'atthañ'c'eva parivār'atthañ'ca deti. dānañ'hi cittaṃ mudukaṃ karoti. yena laddhaṃ hoti, so'pi laddhaṃ me'ti muducitto hoti, yena dinnaṃ, so'pi dinnaṃ mayā'ti muducitto hoti, iti ubhinnam'pi cittaṃ mudukaṃ karoti, ten'eva adantadamanaṃ dānan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: citt'ālaṅ'kāra-cittaparikkhār'atthaṃ dānaṃ deti.
